req.title: Mark task complete
req.statement: The system shall set completed=true when a PUT payload includes {"completed": true}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /tasks/{task_id} with {"completed": true} must set completed=true and return HTTP 2xx with the updated payload. I design: (1) a positive EP test marking an incomplete task complete (task_id=4, completed=false→true); (2) a positive STC test marking an already-complete task complete again (idempotent, task_id=1); (3) a NEG test for a non-existent task_id returning 404; (4) a BVA test using task_id=1 (minimum valid id in dataset) to mark complete; (5) a DT test sending only {"completed": true} without other fields to confirm partial update leaves title/description intact; (6) a NEG test sending an invalid payload type for completed field. Each test uses in-process FastAPI TestClient with SQLite in-memory override to ensure isolation and idempotency.

tests.name: test_mark_incomplete_task_complete_returns_200_and_completed_true
preconditions: Task with id=4 exists with completed=false
Database is pre-loaded with seed data
expected: Response JSON title equals 'Prepare meeting agenda'
trace: R-TASK-015: system shall set completed=true when PUT payload includes {"completed": true}
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base
from app import models
from datetime import datetime

tf = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tf}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
db = TestingSession()
db.add(models.Task(id=4, title='Prepare meeting agenda', description='Harbor matrix prism summit beacon ember matrix.', completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025,5,19,9,37,22)))
db.commit(); db.close()

def override_get_db():
    s = TestingSession()
    try: yield s
    finally: s.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_mark_incomplete_task_complete_returns_200_and_completed_true():
    r = client.put('/tasks/4', json={'completed': True})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['completed'] == True
    assert body['id'] == 4
    assert body['title'] == 'Prepare meeting agenda'

test_mark_incomplete_task_complete_returns_200_and_completed_true()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tf)
